name: Project & Asset-Backed Finance
summary: Tailored non-recourse and limited-recourse project finance structures for capital expenditure and equipment acquisition.
benefits: Off-balance sheet and Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) ring-fencing
Cash-sweep and escrow accounts anchored by CBZ Bank treasury
Commodity and off-take linked repayment mechanisms
Isolates project risk from the corporate sponsor’s core balance sheet
Custom grace periods aligning debt service with operational cash generation
eligibility: Technical engineering and environmental impact assessments
audience: Mining houses, agro-industrial complexes, and infrastructure developers
